name: Ohime-sama Butoukai
source:
The protagonist is tasked with entertaining princesses from various countries who attend the ball.

The grand ball is hosted by his superior, Princess Guinevere, the prime minister of the great nation of Middleland.

The protagonist, invited to entertain princesses from various countries, struggles to marry into wealth. He faces odds with each of the unique princesses.

What will become of the romance?

[Translated from the [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130719224615/http://www.eants.co.jp/game/ohimesama/index.html]official website[/url]]
translation:
主人公受命招待前来参加舞会的各国公主。

这场盛大的舞会，由他的上司——大国米德兰的宰相公主桂妮薇儿主持。

为了迎娶贵女、跻身豪门，负责接待各国公主的主人公拼尽全力，却在一位位个性鲜明的公主面前接连碰壁。

这段恋情，最终将走向何方？

[译自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130719224615/http://www.eants.co.jp/game/ohimesama/index.html]官方网站[/url]]
